representation.state_language: GF(2) RREF plus hash-consed bounded-fanin Boolean DAG with definitional auxiliaries
representation.reversible_equivalence: states related by polynomial-size exact bijective definitional re-encoding of the live semantic interface belong to one quotient class
representation.normalization_steps: may move inside one quotient class and are not allowed to claim semantic progress

progress_contract.strict_decrease_scope: only certified irreversible transitions between quotient classes
progress_contract.anti_alias_rule: no decrease may be certified merely by variable renaming, direct aliases, invertible GF(2) basis changes, or polynomial-size reversible Boolean re-encodings
progress_contract.semantic_reference: continuation-equivalence class count N_R(B|W) and mu=ceil(log2 N_R) are checker gold standards only
progress_contract.operational_requirement: candidate must provide a polynomial-time independently checkable progress certificate without computing an exponential continuation table

first_attack.name: NONINJECTIVE_PROJECTION_WITH_WITNESS_LEDGER
first_attack.question: Can a proposed operational progress certificate distinguish genuine many-to-one semantic projection from reversible re-encoding while preserving enough provenance for SAT witness reconstruction?
positive_controls: pure affine elimination with a genuine rank drop
first_attack.killer_condition: certificate reports strict progress on any negative control or cannot certify a genuine irreversible control without exponential semantic expansion
first_attack.candidate_condition: one uniform polynomial-time certificate passes all controls and composes to a polynomially bounded path to TRUE/FALSE on the frozen representation class
